style: Cut-out subject layer for compositing in a film shot: isolated on a fully transparent background, no ground plane, no cast shadow on the ground, no backdrop, no text. Photorealistic, engraved-paper texture retained on the surface, fine grain, soft ambient occlusion inside crevices, sharp silhouette edges. The lighting stated in each item must be followed exactly — the layer is composited into that specific shot.

items.name: bound_figure
items.prompt: A seated chained human figure seen from behind, shoulders and back only, body reading almost entirely as a dark silhouette. LIGHTING: a hard fire glow from the right rim-lights the right edge of the shoulders and arm; everything else is near black.

items.name: hand_cup
items.prompt: A single weathered human hand holding a shallow bronze cup of dark liquid, forearm entering from the lower right, sleeve falling away. LIGHTING: one hard key from the upper right; the cup rim and the back of the hand catch light, the sleeve and lower left go to black.

items.name: scholar_desk
items.prompt: A monk in a heavy hooded robe leaning over a slanted writing desk, quill in hand on an open manuscript, a small candle and an ink pot on the desk, all as one connected object. LIGHTING: raking golden window light from the left at a low angle, lighting the page and the side of his face, the right side and the background falling into deep shadow.
